name: Home, again pastel instrument
summary: Computational-brutalism structure (square, flat, mono, 3 px rules, plotting grid, inverse panel heads) in bright pastel: cream drafting paper, white surfaces, mint/peach/lavender/sky/butter tints, deep indigo ink, a coral signal and a plotter-blue second accent. Dark mode is a deep plum-navy with the same pastel signals.
use_when: Home, again: a bright pastel instrument around a voxel neighbourhood
signature: an exposed plotting grid: a faint 32 px grid with a stronger line every 160 px, and blocks that sit on it
mono type at real scale: body, headings, figures and the signature moment in JetBrains Mono, the display title in heavy uppercase Pretendard
raw structure on purpose: 3 px section rules, 2 px compartments in line-strong, panel heads as inverse ink bars, square corners everywhere (status dots stay round)

measurement and index labels: every section carries a data-coord label on its rule (sheet, grid reference, revision), ui-coord and ui-ruler name real sizes and positions, ui-frame adds registration crosses
uppercase mono meta: labels, table heads, nav groups, tags and legends in capitals with 0.08 em tracking

a strong signal colour plus a plotter-blue second accent: coral in light, soft apricot in dark, on the primary action and the figure that matters; plotter blue on the second series and featured compartments; mint as the support tint
terminal detail: a ui-prompt with a static block cursor, ui-scan scanlines on readouts (never over body text), stepped motion (steps(3, end))
forbid: rounded corners, pills and soft cards (DS-005 reports any radius off the lock)
blurred or soft drop shadows and offset shadows (DS-007: the lock declares flat elevation)
gradients other than the plotting grid, glassmorphism, glow and neon bloom (CF-404 and the slop register report them)
rainbow charts, more than four accent hue families in one view, or decorative emoji
scanlines or noise over body text; flicker, blinking cursors or animated scan effects
decorative fake data: every coordinate, revision, grid reference or unit id must label something on the page
hiding the structure: borderless floating cards, centred hero text over empty space
